@syntax Repeat
@syntax     statements
@syntax Until condition
Ends a [Repeat](Repeat) loop. The loop goes around again while the condition is false.

```blitzbasic
;run
n = 0
Repeat
	n = n + 1
Until n = 3
Print n
```

```text
3
```
